First of all, let all praise be to Jesus and Mother Mary. I am from Kasaragod.
I made the covenant in 2023. I took it on 28-3-2023.
After that, I was working in Oman. After going to my workplace, in the month of October,
one day in the evening, after finishing my duty and when I was free,
around 7:30, I went outside to have tea. I had parked my vehicle outside the office.
I was sitting in the vehicle and looking at my phone. Just beside my hospital,
there is a multi-specialty hospital. At that hospital, an Omani woman came.
She came right next to my vehicle on that block.
She came and scraped against my vehicle. From the front door to the front bumper,
she hit and damaged the side of my vehicle.
I tried calling her by honking and flashing the headlights. But she did not look back.
I lowered my window glass and tapped on her vehicle twice with my hand, to call her.
Suddenly, she opened her door and came out, and called me “stupid.”
She shouted at me in a very rude way.
After shouting, I asked her, “You hit my vehicle, and then you call me stupid?
Am I the stupid one? Wasn’t it you who showed stupidity?”
When I asked her this, she again shouted at me for some time.
Then she took her vehicle and suddenly exited from there.
After some time, about one hour later, I received a call from the police station.
She also took my vehicle number and left. From the police station I got a call saying, “A case has
been registered in your name.” They said they were calling to inform me that a case had already been registered.
As the accused, I had not even gone there. But before that itself a case had already been registered. They gave
a case number and said, “You must come, and if you do not arrive, tonight itself the police will come to you.”
I said I would come there, and within 10 minutes I went to the station, which was close to me.
Before that, when I called my office and told them about this matter, by that evening all the PROs, the Omanis, had already left. There was no one at all to come with me.
So only my roommate and I went there. When I reached there, immediately they made me sit, and for 10 to 15 minutes I still had my phone and belongings in my hand.
During that time, after I spoke with them, I asked if I could call my office and explain what was happening here.
They told me, “You will be in lockup until Sunday.” This incident had happened on Wednesday evening. They said, “Until Sunday you will not be in the lockup here at the station, but inside the jail.”
Not the single-cell lockup inside a police station like we usually see in movies, but in the jail itself until Sunday.
Only later I came to know that this lady belonged to a high-status family, a Sheikh family, and her father was also working as a high-ranking government officer. Both of them had already come before I reached there.
A case had already been registered in my name. They had quickly spoken with the policemen there and told them, “Keep him in jail for four days, and only then release him.” After saying this, they left.
When I arrived, during those 10–15 minutes, they were not ready to hear anything other than what the lady had already said.
I had called my company and told them these were the events, but since all the PROs had left, no one was
there to help me. They took my phone, wallet, the covenant medal I had wore on my chain.
All of that they took from me. Even my pant belt they removed and took away, and then they put me inside the lockup.
After that, I had no one to speak to. I had no phone, nothing at all. Inside the lockup, there was no one to speak for me.
My roommate was still outside the police station, waiting. I thought no one would come to help me, and I was taken inside the lockup.
When I entered there, I had no covenant medal in my hand, nothing at all.
I was sitting there, reciting only the Creed. I said, “I have done nothing wrong to deserve being kept here. I should not be held here for four days. Tonight itself I must be allowed to leave.”
My company told me, “There is nothing we can do now. Only on Sunday will we be able to act.”
I sat there for one and a half to three hours at the police station doing nothing. No one listened to
what I was saying, and the Arab policemen, from the juniors to those in higher posts, came and shouted at me.
I said, they were not even ready to hear a single thing I was saying. After keeping me there for three hours, they took me to the jail.
They opened three or four doors, and it was the fourth door—the main door—where they put me inside the lockup, inside the jail.
They handed me two black sheets and told me, “You will stay here until Sunday.”
They spoke to me very rudely. I was made to sit on the floor there, and I began reciting the Creed. I did not know the apparition prayer by heart.
I continued reciting the Creed. They would not allow me to lie down at night. I recited the Creed
continuously for 45 minutes, and I did not even know how much I had recited.
Then the policemen came and told me, “You may go back now,” and they called me and said,
“If you are in this cell because of a woman, you will be released only by a high-ranking female police officer in our department. That is the officer who will release you from here.”
That police officer said this to me in a very surprising way. He looked at me sternly and told me that I would be released by her. That is how they finally let me go.
When I was released and looked around, a PRO from my company was there. This police officer is his relative.
For no trivial reason could he have called this lady. The officer is related to someone in a post similar to an IG (Inspector General).
He spoke to the ordinary policemen in various ways. Seeing that no one agreed, in the end my PRO called and spoke to the lady.
When they inquired with her, it turned out that the lady who had filed the complaint against me, along with her father, had filed the case with her ego hurt because of her status.
They decided that I would be kept in jail for four days and only after that released. They told me not to be
held there unnecessarily and that I would be released from jail tonight itself. They also told me I would be taken to my flat.
Outside, my company’s PRO and my roommate had been waiting all this time for about four hours. My roommate is a Muslim, and the PRO is also a Muslim.
They waited there for me all this time at the police station. In total, I was at the police station till 2 am, night before being released from jail.
Until I was released, these Muslim friends of mine had been waiting there for me for four to five hours.
After this incident, seeing that things at the police station had not gone as they had expected, they elevated the case to court.
The case, which should have been sent to a primary court, was instead sent to the High Court. There is no District Court there; only the High Court and the Supreme Court exist.
After sending it to the High Court, they pursued me regarding this case for an entire year. During that time, I had not told anyone at home about this matter. My work and affairs continued as usual.
Everything went on as normal because I did not face any major difficulties. Only later did I realize that I had been caught in a criminal case.
After that, we were put under a travel ban. We could only leave that country once the case was concluded—then we could exit to any country or back to our own country.
A whole year passed, and in October 2023, this case, which had started in October, had still not concluded even by October 2024. The case was not finished, and my judgment had not come.
I went to the court for hearings five times. In December, my father had a medical attack and was hospitalized.
On December 29, the judgment for my case had still not arrived. I needed to go back home, but only
my younger brother and my mother were there. My brother was working, and there was no one else to help.
Suddenly, only my mother ran to help. I thought, “I have to get home quickly and that my father had been hospitalized but because of this case,
I had no one to help me get back home. On December 29, my father was in the hospital. On December 30, the judgment for my case came, and they said the case against me was dismissed.
The court dismissed the case in my name. I got CCTV records and visuals from my company, but they were all blurred. In front of the office…
In front of my office was a garage workshop, a premium workshop. They only retrieved the hard disk six months later.
After six months, they took it, searched it, and gave me corrected visuals from start to finish.
I had made my company lawyer handle it. I submitted the video in court through that lawyer. Because of that, in this case, by watching the video, they saw that I was not at fault.
The video visuals included my voice. There was also a camera slightly above that captured interactions with me, which neither I nor anyone else had seen.
The garage owner himself came and told me, “There is a camera here. If you had not gotten visuals from your office camera, our camera…”
They retrieved the visuals and gave them to me, including the voice. The woman coming and going, shouting, all of that—was recorded with the correct voice.
When they saw this, the lady’s family side in the court became irrelevant. Everything was cleared before even going to court.
Before the case was resolved in court, my company’s criminal lawyer had to intervene.
If needed, it would have cost them 450,000 rupees for a criminal lawyer to argue the case in the High Court. The company told me, “This case is at your own risk; you have to handle it yourself.”
I did not tell anyone at home. I thought, I can deduct it from my salary or take it from my settlement; no problem. Things would continue normally at home without anyone knowing.
I thought, after the case is finished and I needed to go to my father, the case will already be correctly resolved. Mother blessed it, and my case was concluded.
Before that, when I was leaving the police station, my police officers told me, “You were detained because of a woman, and moreover because of a very influential woman…”
They told me that I was released from there, and I have strong faith that it was my mother who came and got me released from there. Also, the local woman who had held me there…
If that same local woman had kept me detained, it would have been her responsibility. But the same woman released me. After this case was resolved, the lawyer had to be paid 450,000.
From the court, there would be a minimum jail sentence and a fine. According to the court verdict, including some court charges and police station documentation, I had to pay about 150 rials.
For such a case, I was told I would only need to pay a fine of 2,000–3,000 rials. Additionally, I might have had to serve a jail sentence for up to six months.
I was told that paying about 150 rials as expenses for both would be sufficient. After paying that, I was able to go to my father in the hospital the next day.
Once the judgment came and the fine was paid, I could travel to my hometown. Then, I had to pay about 450,000 Rupees i.e 1600 Omani rials as lawyer fees.
The company had told me that this could be deducted from my salary in small installments. After some time, I occasionally contacted my director.
I asked politely if anything could be done. At first, the person said nothing could be done. During the next Ramadan month,
I asked once or twice, and again after Ramadan ended. The person said, “Okay, full expenses will be covered by the company.”
The company itself handled all the criminal case expenses, without taking a single penny from me. I had no financial liability at all.
My Mother personally came to the company, to the jail, to the police station, and to the court to support me in every way.
After all this was over, a few months later, I returned to my hometown. After some months, my two friends
and I were together. The company had provided me with a car, a costly one worth about 1–2.5 million rials.
The vehicle that came was a new vehicle; it had been with us for only a month. During lunch break, we took this vehicle and went to a nearby super mall. After going to the mall,
when we returned and were about to leave, my friend told me, “I will drive the vehicle now.” He took the vehicle, entered the highway, and at a traffic signal, without looking ahead,
he drove into it. An oncoming vehicle collided with ours from the front, completely damaging the front to the back. My
front engine room and engine were completely smashed, the dashboard got pushed in, the gearbox inside got destroyed, and it went back between the two seats. It was such an
accident that three people were in the vehicle, but none of us felt any serious harm, as if nothing had happened, similar to how onlookers might see after another accident.
